title: 54430006-Dead_or_Alive_1_Ultimate.xiso.iso
judge: python3 docs/lanes/flip474/lockread.py --from 151 --to 288 <result-id>; the route's menu-start/menu-a/play shots in the window, by eye
prediction: PILOT, one arm, no B. The ref is master 84d2e83cef plus the perflog-only [lock474] counter (pgraph.c), which changes nothing a shipping build does. It answers the two questions the #474 fix depends on and that nothing on disk answers: which PGRAPH register DOA Ultimate reads while it waits (NV_PGRAPH_STATUS is never written, so pg->lock is the guest's only 'engine busy' signal and a lockless read of an idle poll would be a semantic change, not a timing one), and what the puller is doing while the vCPU waits (FLIP_STALL's surface_update, its flip_stall op, or other methods). The window is lane.slowdown462's DOA1U fight, 151-288 s after logcat line 1 on the survey route, which fought during the menu rounds from about the 8th START. The fix design and the A/B prediction are registered on this answer, before the fix is written.

legs.M0 (instrument): >= 30 [lock474] lines and >= 20 gfps lines in 151-288 s, and the route's shots in that window show a fight (stage, fighters, paused or not). Otherwise the pilot is VOID, not a zero, and the window is re-picked from the shots once.
legs.P0 (premise, re-measured): read lock wait >= 0.25 of wall in the window. lane.slowdown462's off-CPU profile (a593d8eb85, not perflog) had 14.6 s of 30 = 0.49. FAILS in the world where a perflog build of current master does not reproduce the wait; then the A/B's lock-wait leg cannot be read off [lock474] and needs the off-CPU profile route instead.
legs.P1 (where the puller is): (rd_fs + rd_fo) >= 0.6 of the read wait: the vCPU waits behind FLIP_STALL. FAILS in the world where the wait is behind other methods' lock holds (per-draw surface_update, mid-frame finishes); then no flip-only change (design F) can remove it and the brief's premise is wrong for this build.
legs.P2 (a guess, labelled as one): rd_fo > rd_fs: the flip_stall op (the profile's attribution) and not FLIP_STALL's surface_update (the perflog soak's 60 ms Surf). The rival is the perflog reading. Either result is kept; it decides whether design F (drop the lock across the flip's fence wait, which is inside the op) can reach the wait at all.
legs.P3 (the question, not predicted): the register carrying the most read wait, and its share (>= 0.5 expected: one poll loop). Decision rule written now: if it is 0x700 (STATUS) or INTR (0x100) or any register a guest reads to learn the engine is idle, design R (lockless reads) is rejected for it; if it is a register the puller writes but that carries no idle meaning (e.g. SURFACE 0x710, the flip indices), R restricted to that register is the candidate.
legs.P4 (counter cost): gfps median in the window between 11 and 16 (slowdown462's e5db66fa37 perflog soak of the same window: 13.0 by lockread.py, 13.19 by their reader). FAILS if the counter itself moves the frame rate; then it must be made cheaper before any A/B reads it.

expect_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a soak writes no captures. The legs are read off the [lock474] and gfps lines by lockread.py, and the shots by eye.
